observation.command:
echo "=== Does the dev server (3000, tooling) see NEXTAUTH_SECRET? Check .env.local loaded by next dev ==="
docker exec vereinfacht-tooling-1 grep -E 'NEXTAUTH_SECRET|API_BEARER_TOKEN' /var/www/html/web_application/.env.local | sed -E 's/=(.).*/=\1[REDACTED]/'
echo
echo "=== next dev log tail (check for NO_SECRET / errors) ==="
docker exec vereinfacht-tooling-1 tail -20 /tmp/next_dev.log 2>&1 | grep -iE 'secret|error|ready|compiled' | head
